reason: The cited evidence (E1) discusses Hall-Petch behavior and grain size-dependent strength in CoCrFeMnNi, not MoNbTaW, and does not address ductility, grain boundary sliding, annealing effects, or impact energy release. It provides no specific support for any of the key premises.
premises: HPT can refine grain structure in refractory HEAs to ultrafine/nanocrystalline scale
Ultrafine/nanocrystalline grains activate grain boundary sliding and improve ductility
Post-deformation annealing stabilizes the refined structure without causing embrittlement
Grain refinement via SPD does not sacrifice high strength
Impact-induced energy release is maintained after HPT and annealing
